description: 6K (formerly Amastan Technologies) uses proprietary advanced plasma processing and industrial systems to create materials that are enabling the next-generation of commercial and consumer products. The company focuses on developing critical materials used to manufacture silicon wafers, LED lighting, powders for industrial 3D printing, advanced battery technologies, and thermal coatings.

6K Additive produces high-performance metal powders for additive manufacturing. Its proprietary manufacturing process allows it to produce powders for aerospace, medical, and industrial applications. Its innovative UniMelt ® microwave plasma process leverages sustainable sources to produce high-quality powder that is truly spherical, void of porosity and satellites with better flowability than competing technologies.
Adaptive Surface Technologies is a high-tech materials company that creates fully slippery coatings for multiple industries including manufacturing, marine vessels, and medical devices.

Developing advanced optimization software that streamlines additive manufacturing workflows, enabling rapid, repeatable, and high-quality production by integrating design, material, and process parameters into a unified, goal-driven platform.

Ai-Media is a global leader in the provision of high-quality live and recorded captioning, transcription and translation services. Its unique technology platform combines artificial intelligence and human expertise to deliver market-leading speech-to-text accuracy.
AM Batteries specializes in dry-electrode manufacturing for lithium-ion batteries by eliminating solvent recovery and electrode drying to reduce the energy consumption of a battery plant.
Leading the development of portable disease management devices.
Arduino designs, manufactures, and supports electronic devices and software, allowing people around the world to easily access advanced technologies that interact with the physical world.
Aspinity is transforming the design of always-on sensing devices that run on battery through the world’s first ultra-low power, analog machine learning RAMP chip.

Axsun Technologies develops and manufactures industry-leading optical coherence tomography (OCT) and near-infrared (NIR) MEMS-based optical engines for medical imaging, industrial analysis, and telecommunications.

Azumo (formerly FLEx Lighting) is a breakthrough light transmission company revolutionizing the display industry. FLEx-enabled displays give electronic gadgets up to 10x the battery savings and a way to be seen in direct sunlight without glare on the screen.
Banyan Biomarkers developed the first FDA-approved blood test that detects mild traumatic brain injuries (TBIs).

Zeteo Tech and its 2020 spinout BioFlyte have recombined under a new name, Spectara, putting product development and commercial teams back under one roof to advance pathogen-agnostic biothreat detection and real-time infectious disease detection
Bioskyrb develops genomic amplification technologies which deliver higher coverage and fidelity for various gene sequencing applications.
Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering engineered macrophage therapies (CAR-M) to treat solid tumors by engaging both innate and adaptive immune responses.

Codetta is a multi-omics technology company developing a next generation quantitative and digital platform for nucleic acid and protein assays with unprecedented levels of sensitivity and simultaneous analyte detection.
AI-driven discovery company focused on naturally existing proteins that show the potential to be turned into superior therapeutics using AI and deep mutagenesis.
Spinning out of Harvard University, CytoTronics is building the next generation of complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) electronics technology for cell measurement and manipulation.

e-Zinc is a zinc-air battery company based in Toronto. The company’s energy storage system can be up to 80 percent less expensive than comparable lithium-ion systems for long-duration applications. Importantly, its energy storage system can operate in cold and hot climates, and is made of abundant and recyclable materials.
Edge Precision Manufacturing designs and manufactures fully customized microstructured thermoplastic devices for diagnostic, medical, and optics applications.
EnaChip is building magnetics that enable next-generation switches for AI data centers.

EnCharge AI is developing a robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology to provide orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions.

Envoy Medical Corporation develops innovative, fully-implanted hearing devices, including the Esteem® middle ear implant and the investigational Acclaim® cochlear implant, advancing access and usability in hearing technology.
Excision BioTherapeutics is a biotechnology company developing CRISPR-based therapies to cure viral infection diseases and improve the lives of chronically ill patients.

ExOne is a leading provider of industrial 3D printers and on-demand manufacturing services specializing in binder jetting technology. Its systems use powder-based additive manufacturing to produce complex components, sand molds and cores, and parts from materials including sand, metals, ceramics, and polymers. ExOne serves industries including automotive, aerospace, energy, and heavy manufacturing.
Exyn Technologies is pioneering multi-platform robotic autonomy for complex, GPS-denied environments.

Framework Computer is a technology company dedicated to creating modular and repairable laptops, computers and other devices that are easy to upgrade, repair and customize. Framework aims to reduce electronic waste and promote a circular economy in the tech industry. Their mission is to redefine the relationship between consumers and technology, providing high-performing products that are environmentally responsible and adaptable to individual needs.

GelSight develops portable, non-destructive elastomeric 3D imaging systems used to improve quality control processes in aerospace, automotive and other high-value industries. The proprietary technology that was invented at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology provides extremely detailed and rapid surface measurements and robotic sensing capabilities.

ImmunoScape provides a proprietary immune profiling solution, focused on high-dimensional profiling of T-cell populations by antigen specificity and phenotype, for use in the development of immunotherapies and therapeutic vaccines, and as a companion diagnostic.

InterVenn Biosciences utilizes a proprietary glycoproteomic biomarker interrogation platform using AI and mass spectrometry for next-gen precision medicine. The company is working to find new solutions in ovarian, pancreatic, liver, prostate, and kidney cancer, together with applications from the Vista suite of solutions for treatment and monitoring, immune profiling, patient stratification, and disease progression.

iTel is a national provider of business services, including voice, connectivity, networking, and cloud. As a converged network company, we harness the power of every Canadian carrier and every technology to create an affordable network solution for any sized business – in even the most remote locations across Canada and the US.
Lightship is a management platform with a suite of features for communication, real-time data collection and analysis, and emergency response for commercial worksites and municipal services.
Liquid Instruments develops the Moku:Lab, a software-reconfigurable device for real-time signal processing that brings a new level of flexibility in the lab, in the field, or on the production line.
High-brightness micro-displays for augmented reality and other display applications.
MedCrypt combines cybersecurity technology products with management consulting, decision science, and regulatory strategy focused on supporting medical device manufacturers.

Developing advanced analytical instruments that leverage high-resolution ion mobility mass spectrometry (HRIM-MS) and Structures for Lossless Ion Manipulation (SLIM) technology to enable faster, more accurate characterization of complex molecules, enhancing disease diagnosis, drug development, and biomarker discovery.
MultiMechanics develops state-of-the-art, multi-scale finite element software systems to help companies using advanced materials greatly reduce physical prototyping and testing.
NanoCellect is a developer of microfluidic cell sorting technologies for the biotech industry.
This drastically reduces the time needed for design iterations and performance optimization, making high-precision simulations more accessible and cost effective.
Niron is developing innovative advanced magnetic materials for high performance, low cost permanent magnets.

Nirrin delivers non-invasive, non-destructive, real-time, in-process monitoring of aqueous solutions that can enable improved process control, faster process development, and adaptive manufacturing for the biopharma and life science industries.

NTx develops a cell-free process to produce biologics of high purity, stability, and low cost. The firm has the world’s first fully recombinant cell-free system based on thermophile strains and using continuous flow bioreactors.
NUBURU is manufacturing the world’s first high-power blue laser for metal cutting, welding, and additive manufacturing.
Developing nanoparticle-based delivery systems for RNA, DNA, and biologics to enable safer, more effective treatments.
OTI Lumionics is making advanced OLED technology accessible to innovative new product applications.

Slyce is the world’s leading visual search company and provides a fully integrated product for retailers’ mobile platforms that uses artificial intelligence and advanced image recognition technology to help users find what they are looking for. In 2020, Slyce combined with Catchoom and Humai to form Partium and expand into Europe and build its base of industrial clients.
location: Vienna, Austria, with management in Germany and the United States

description: Pivotal Systems provides best-in-class monitoring and process control technology for the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
Sofregen is a biotechnology company developing products for medical aesthetics and reconstructive surgery.

South 8 Technologies is a pioneer in electrolyte formulations for next-generation lithium batteries. Its patented technology enables a substantial increase in energy, improved safety, and an exceptionally wide operating temperature.

Spectara is a biotechnology and security technology company that develops advanced aerosol detection systems to identify known and emerging biological threats in real time. Its technology supports biosecurity and infectious disease detection, helping government agencies, healthcare providers, and private sector organizations detect harmful bacteria, viruses, spores, and toxins.
Highly advanced meta-optics technology powering next-generation camera modules and imaging systems.
Voltaiq developed and deploys a comprehensive analytics platform to accelerate battery product development and ensure performance, predictability and reliability.

voxeljet is a leading provider of large-format, high-speed 3D printers and on-demand services for industrial and commercial customers. Its powder-based additive manufacturing technology produces complex components from materials such as sand and plastic, serving sectors including automotive, aerospace, film and entertainment, art and architecture, engineering, and consumer goods.

XGS provides access to affordable, carbon-free 24/7 power generation by dramatically increasing the scalability of geothermal energy through its heat harvesting technology. XGS is uniquely positioned to address the growing needs for access to sustainable, local power generation and energy security.
